title: Planet Tweaks V2.8.3 NOVA TITAN 🪐 — Real Cloud Website Auth, Butter-Smooth Esports Pill Sliders, Double-Edit Aim Fix & Zero Animation Purge
releaseNotes: Real Cloud Website Authentication: Integrated Google sign-in directly with https://planettweakz.vercel.app/login.html, completely removing developer placeholders and syncing your GamerTag and presets seamlessly. Butter-Smooth Esports Pill Sliders: Redesigned macro sliders into high-precision matte obsidian capsules with non-blocking track capture, eliminating mouse dragging stutters and sticking. Double-Edit Aim Fix: Removed legacy MarkC binary mouse curves from Pro Packs to restore 1:1 hardware raw input and stop Fortnite tile selection desyncs. Zero Animation Purge Pack: Added a dedicated one-click Pro Pack that strips OS window zoom swoops, taskbar slides, menu fades, transparency, and browser tab animations for 0ms instantaneous UI response. Fullscreen Auto-Hide Taskbar: Sub-pixel bottom margin allows mouse hovering to reveal auto-hidden taskbars effortlessly in maximized mode. Clean Container Tab: Cleaned Random tab ready for custom sub-tab nesting.
